notes.title: Patch 1.8.5.3 🗡️
notes.content:
[p]Hello guys, good news!

The Patch 1.8.5.3 for [b]The Land Beneath Us[/b] is here!

A brand-new "[b]Blessing & Curse[/b]" pack is now available in the Soul Shard Shop, unlocked after completing the main story. This update brings new weapons, relics, chips, and a challenging new quest. We've also added fresh animations, refined balance and status effects, and fixed numerous bugs to improve gameplay across the board. We're also working on a Resume feature, allowing players to leave or exit the game and continue later from where they left off.
 [/p][h2]New Contents:[/h2][p]
[b]Blessing & Curse pack[/b]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43037518/20878ae796d35a1d4ad17a799c51254bd60f134e.png"][/img]The soul shard shop unlocks after completing the main story.  A new pack, "Blessing & Curse” has now been released! It includes:

[/p][h2][b]Weapons[/b][/h2][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43037518/c1d8ea413efd478131e239fb0e03c534ee5addd9.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Blessing Katana
[/b]
[u]Cost[/u]: 20,000 soul shards

[u]Description[/u]: Hit an enemy 1 tile away, then move to the tile behind them. When hitting the enemy, 10% chance to receive a random buff for 3 turns. Max Level: Increases to 20% chance.[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43037518/de38a44a16a70838a797a13308ec4e9e10b77863.gif"][/img][/p][p][b]Blessing Sniper
[/b]
[u]Cost[/u]: 20,000 soul shards

[u]Description[/u]: Fire a shot 5 tiles away. Damage depends on the hit range. 10% chance to gain a random buff for 3 turns when hitting an enemy. Max level: Fires a shot 7 tiles away instead.  [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43037518/5d22891816a68068c9964de57536b7c7b8267b0d.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]Curse Sniper
[/b]
[u]Cost[/u]: 20,000 soul shards

[u]Description[/u]: Fire a shot 7 tiles away. Damage depends on the hit range and status effect turns. 20% chance to gain a random buff for 2 turns when hitting an enemy. Curse: 20% chance to gain a random debuff for 2 turns when hitting an enemy. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43037518/3a179b7b7c0df31af1f0aa5c506dd595bf0ac7ba.gif"][/img][/p][h2]
[b]Relics[/b]
[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43037518/a7ee937330eb8e75c97f614f2d0a5ff66faaef2c.png"][/img][/p][p]
[b]Red Counting Box[/b]

[u]Cost[/u]: 20,000 soul shards
[u]Rarity[/u]: Epic

[u]Description[/u]: You have a +5% critical chance per each type of status effect you have. (Total status effects: x types)(Current: +x% critical chance)(Max: x%)

[u]Enhanced description[/u]: You have a +10% critical chance per each type of status effect you have. (Total status effects: x types)(Current: +x% critical chance)(Max: x%)

[b]Yellow Counting Box[/b]

[u]Cost[/u]: 20,000 soul shards
[u]Rarity[/u]: Epic

[u]Description[/u]: You have a +2.5% dodge chance per each type of status effect you have. (Total status effects: x types)(Current: +x% dodge chance)(Max: x%)

[u]Enhanced description[/u]: You have a +5% dodge chance per each type of status effect you have. (Total status effects: x types)(Current: +x% dodge chance)(Max: x%)[/p][p][/p][p][b]Orange Counting Box[/b]

[u]Cost[/u]: 20,000 soul shards
[u]Rarity[/u]: Epic

[u]Description[/u]: You have a +2.5% critical DMG chance per each type of status effect you have. (Total status effects: x types)(Current: +x% critical DMG)(Max: x%)

[u]Enhanced description[/u]: You have a +5% critical DMG chance per each type of status effect you have. (Total status effects: x types)(Current: +x% critical DMG)(Max: x%)

[b]Black Counting Box[/b]

[u]Cost[/u]: 20,000 soul shards
[u]Rarity[/u]: Legendary

[u]Description[/u]: Increase other Counting Box limit effects by +10%.You have +1 base DMG per each type of status effect you have. (Total status effects: x types)(Current: +x base DMG)

[u]Enhanced description[/u]: Increase other Counting Box limit effects by +20%.You have +1 base DMG per each type of status effect you have. (Total status effects: x types)(Current: +x base DMG)

[b]Chips[/b]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43037518/d16406ca3c960aa8ed6493c4aa63a55dcdc0afc9.png"][/img][/p][p]
[b]Random Buff
[/b]
[u]Cost[/u]: 20,000 soul shards
[u]Lv.1 Description[/u]: Cast Random Buff. Applies 2 random buffs to self for 2 turns.

[b]Fast Forward
[/b]
[u]Cost[/u]: 20,000 soul shards
[u]Lv.1 Description[/u]: Cast Fast Forward. Resets all chips and teleport cooldown immediately.

[b]Consume Wave[/b]

[u]Cost[/u]: 30,000 soul shards[/p][p][u]Lv.1 Description[/u]: Cast Consume Wave. Consumes all your buffs and debuffs to randomly deal 11 - 15 DMG per stack to all enemies.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Gloria

tags.feature: A brand-new "Blessing & Curse" pack is now available in the Soul Shard Shop, unlocked after completing the main story. This update brings new weapons, relics, chips, and a challenging new quest. We've also added fresh animations, refined balance and status effects, and fixed numerous bugs to improve gameplay across the board. We're also working on a Resume feature, allowing players to leave or exit the game and continue later from where they left off.
Added a new status effect: Receive Souls Per Hit Chance Description: Your attacks have a x% chance to receive 3 Souls or Soul Shards.
Added 2 new Sven animations: Shooting by "Gun” and "Sniper”

tags.bug: Fixed an issue where Zero Sven might not spawn.
Fixed an issue where Nuada’s image in the Boss Archive was incorrect.
Fixed an issue where Chip Mode automatically switched from Manual to Auto when the chip was activated.
Fixed an issue where the Hidden Dagger relic had no effect on bosses.

Fixed an issue where the Additional Flat Damage was calculated multiple times in a single turn.

Fixed an issue where the Permanent Immunity status effect displayed two icons when the player enhanced the Band of Immunity relic.
Fixed an issue where some status effect icons displayed incorrect values.
Fixed an issue where a status effect icon was not disabled after being used.
Fixed an issue where challenge conditions were not reset when entering another mode.

notes.title: 📢 Patch 1.8.4 📢
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43037518/d396cdf3efd3e04a44af8d57e49af5840934e9c3.jpg[/img]

Hello everyone,

The Patch 1.8.4 for The Land Beneath Us is here! This update includes a brand-new hidden boss, gameplay balancing improvements, and bug fixes.

Check out the full patch notes below!
🕓 Release Date: March 6th at 4 PM CET

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2131010/The_Land_Beneath_Us/

Check out the full [b]patch notes[/b] below!

[u][b]Patch 1.8.4:[/b][/u]

[b][u]New Update:[/u][/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Added a new condition:[/b] Chance to encounter the hidden boss in Purple Moon mode.
[*] [b]Added a new hidden boss:[/b] [i]Nuadain[/i] Purple Moon mode.
[/list]
[b][u]Balancing & Gameplay Changes:[/u][/b]
[list]
[*] Implemented stun immunity for bosses and enemies while they are invincible.
[*] Added a teleport cooldown when the player gets disarmed.
[*] Rebalanced the Hidden Sacred Sword quest: Reduced the shield gain condition from 1000 to 300.
[/list]
[b][u]Bug Fixes:[/u][/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the player couldn't defeat the Creator boss.
[*] Fixed an issue where shields were not working properly with bosses.
[*] Fixed an issue where Sven could stand on the same tile as bosses and enemies.
[*] Fixed an issue where the HP increase percentage in Purple Moon mode was incorrect.
[*] Fixed an issue where enemies stunned by Armguard could still create attack pre-tiles but wouldn’t attack.
[*] Fixed an issue where getting stunned during the skip-turn tutorial prevented the player from returning to the room’s start position.
[*] Fixed an issue where the player could walk while the background was still loading.
[*] Fixed an issue where the player could move during cutscenes.
[*] Fixed an issue where the background music played incorrectly.
[/list]
If you have any question or bug reports, join our [url=https://discord.gg/SjCZPGRVHX]Discord[/url] or send us a message on the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2131010/discussions/]Steam Community Hub[/url]. (It helps a lot ♥)

notes.title: 🔥 Patch 1.7.7.2 🔥
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43037518/8148a0d3cafe30c48bdf13cb1aea1f931821b813.jpg[/img]

Hi,

The patch 1.7.7.2 is now live! Check out the full patch notes below!

[h3]Bug Fixes:[/h3]

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the Skull Tech Warlock attacks outside the pre-tile when the totem is dead.
[*] Fixed an issue where all King Slime were spawning an incorrect number of slimes.
[*] Fixed an issue where the Skull Venom didn't transfer to full mode when stepping on an enemy's poison tile.
[*] Fixed an issue where the Changeling pilot spawned outside the map.
[*] Fixed an issue where the impact equipment was impacting in the wrong direction and at the wrong turn.
[*] Fixed an issue where the Dual Gun was attacking at the wrong range.
[*] Fixed an issue where a typo in the Thai localization for the follow-up equipment.
[*] Fixed an issue where the follow-up didn't activate with knockback.
[*] Fixed an issue where the follow-up equipment activated the follow-up on the wrong turn.
[*] Fixed an issue where players could enter cutscenes that had already been encountered.
[*] Fixed an issue where players got stuck after dropping the enhanced Band Of Immunity in Chinese language version.
[*] Fixed an issue where the Pwyll’s Sword calculated the wrong extra damage.
[*] Fixed an issue where the chip become disabled after receiving the disarm status during its activating turn.
[*] Fixed an issue where the stack equipment reset its stacks when dropped.
[*] Fixed an issue where Carman’s attack wasn’t working correctly after the animation trigger.
[*] Fixed an issue where the Skull Elemental Knight could still cast attacks after being stunned.
[*] Fixed an issue where the weapon's damage wasn't displayed in the weapon activation settings panel.
[*] Fixed an issue where the Enhancer Crystal calculated the chance for double upgrades on equipment every time it was picked up.
[*] Fixed an issue where blind enemies could still apply attack status effects to the player.
[*] Fixed an issue where the portal wouldn't open after clearing the room.
[*] Fixed an issue where no relics appeared in the relic selection.
[*] Fixed an issue where players could hit the invisible Skull Element Knight.
[*] Fixed an issue where the player couldn't move in the lobby scene on the Xbox platform after logging out and logging back in with the same user.
[/list]

[h3]Balancing & Gameplay Changes[/h3]

[list]
[*] Implemented new warp logic for Dullahan’s sword, allowing it to warp behind any living enemy.
[/list]

If you have any question or bug reports, join our [url=https://discord.gg/SjCZPGRVHX]Discord[/url] or send us a message on the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2131010/discussions/]Steam Community Hub[/url]. (It helps a lot ♥)

notes.title: Patch Note 1.7.3
notes.content:
Implemented Steam cloud save
After opening chests, the items will now spawn between the player and the portal.
 
Bug Fixes:

Fixed the issue where some characters were missing in Traditional Chinese language.
Fixed the issue where East and West regions were inverted.
Fixed the issue where the visual display of Permanent Immunity was missing at the bottom left.
Fixed the issue where swapping Vel Armor with another relic and picking it up caused the player to lose HP.
Fixed the issue allowing players to pick duplicate relics.
Fixed the issue where slime/spider/hound animation froze after attacking player.
Fixed the issue where chest assets were not loaded.
Fixed the issue where Bloody Edge stack reset to zero when upgraded.
Fixed the issue where Overkill Spear did not trigger the Overkill relic correctly.
Fixed the issue where another final boss map didn't appear after completing the game.
Fixed the issue causing enemies to always have immunity.
Fixed the issue where Abyssal Dagger and Trinity Code could lead to incorrect chip cooldown.
Fixed the issue where the Skull Tech Warlock's spawn totem would sometimes appear in the lava/poison tile.
Fixed the issue where enemy kills with status effects were not being counted.
Fixed the resolution responsiveness issue of the main menu.
Fixed the scroll bar bug in the Moon World selection screen.
Fixed the looping sound issue when holding the button in the core upgrade menu.
Fixed the issue where player can duplicate relic when closing the swap item UI.

Localization Updates:

Updated Chinese localization.
Updated Thai localization.

Balancing & Gameplay Changes:

Units will not inflict stun again for 3 turns after the initial stun.
Updated the miniboss room (4 Kings) in TGA right wing.
Rebalanced the relics drop rate.
Adjusted the Zero Saber/Equilibrium to have a maximum stack of 10.
Adjusted HP calculations to reflect percentage changes when max HP is altered.


Fork (normal): When activating Overkill‚ you have a 25% chance to apply 1 Shield to self.
Fork (enhanced): When activating Overkill‚ you have a 50% chance to apply 1 Shield to self.


Basher (enhanced): When attacking a Stunned enemy‚ you deal +200% bonus damage. When attacking the enemy‚ you have a 10% chance to apply 2 Stun to the enemy.


Red Piggy Bank (normal): You gain base DMG corresponding to 2% of your gold. (Max: 15 base DMG)
Red Piggy Bank (enhanced): You gain base DMG corresponding to 5% of your gold. (Max: 15 base DMG)


Poison: At the end of the turn‚ deal DMG equal to 10% of max HP; against bosses‚ deal DMG equal to 5% of their max HP. (Ignore Shield)

Shield: Block DMG 1 time per stack. Stack will not decrease at the end of turn. (Max: 10 stacks)


Typo:

Green Piggy Bank (enhanced): You gain max HP corresponding to 10% of your highest gold. (Max: 100 max HP)

notes.title: Dev Blog #2
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43037518/d537b70dbd6a077f8d3fb6c5dcd8e09eb39d5b3d.jpg[/img]

Hello Underworld Dwellers,

6 days to go until the release, yes, the May 13, are you excited about it? [strike](You have to be excited ...) 😠[/strike]

Sorry, a bit rude, let's get back to the topic, today we're going to talk about two of the changes that we've made in game. Too much talking, wait, if you haven't joined our [url=https://discord.gg/SjCZPGRVHX]official The Land Beneath Us Discord[/url] for the Demo Speed Run Challenge... it's now the time (you may have a chance to win a key)! 😎

[h3][url=https://thelandbeneathus.com/]Download the Demo and Wishlist NOW![/url][/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2131010/The_Land_Beneath_Us/

Okok, I should stop talking, let's get started!
[hr][/hr] [h2]😔 It hurts, it really hurts ... 😔[/h2]

[strike]My precious,[/strike] Vel Armor, our precious let's say, is nerfed. Balancing is always the problem that we want to improve so that we can provide an endless experience, generally speaking, we wanna offer you more choices in terms of relics and weapons instead of only focusing on getting the Vel Armor. 

So in the full game, the Vel Armor will only give you 50% to heal 1 HP, otherwise, you need to upgrade it to get the 100% healing. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43037518/4de4ecada5e7f81f2b04ec3ad670449a49498393.png[/img]
[hr][/hr] [h2]🤖 Do you think this is the end? No, never 🤖[/h2]

We won't let you go like this, we wanna you, to retrieve more and more Soul Energies 😎 We are insatiable ahahaha. 

Anyway, we have added the World Customization after you finished the run in the area. As you can see in the screenshot below, there are maximum 5 levels. You have to complete the 1st level before moving on to the 2nd level. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43037518/789fe8946f7971b241d775a6f111aa5b8de297a5.png[/img]
A higher level can give you more soul rewards and more difficulty. To get started, simply just add conditions on the right hand side to fill in the gauge point! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43037518/8f3a769293e866b107c600be73875786935e0eb1.png[/img]
You can add as many conditions as you want, but you have to respect the maximum gauge points that you have in each level. From level 0 to level 1, you need and can accumulate a maximum of 5 gauge points, and 10 for level 2, and so on. Attention, some conditions may get you 3 gauge points when it's enabled! 

[b]From level 0 to level 1 (I add more than 5 gauge points, but it's still at 5/5 as I'm in level 0)[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43037518/d59044349abb1dfcb73008346cbdca5bffaaeb61.png[/img]
[b]From level 1 to level 2[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43037518/b77221a9e25d3157b21adaedb4c6a53bd915ddae.png[/img]
Challenge yourself, fill in the Gauge Point and collect bonus soul energies! Are you up to the Challenge?
[hr][/hr] Thank you for your support! See you very soon!

Cheers,

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43037518/63a86491ee49e7a1c46638995ca5452c6fb32b46.jpg[/img]

Hello Underworld Dwellers, 

Long time no see... Not really, we just retrieved tons of soul energies during the Steam Next Fest! Not bad not bad! Today let's talk about our latest development process of the game?

By the way, just a friendly reminder, the demo is still available. Try it out if you haven't already. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2131010/The_Land_Beneath_Us/

[h2]🤖 Chip System Upgrade: Your turn to activate 🤖[/h2]

Have you ever found yourself in a situation where you dun wanna use a specific combo in the next turn? No worries! You can now execute the combo whenever you are well-placed, and ready to use it! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43037518/b805824da9cebfff1bfe9f10b5262953a17c7af0.gif[/img]

[h2]😡 We need EXPLANATIONS!!! OK ... there you go 💚[/h2]

Actually, we wanna show the details in-game to explain the effects like Overkill, Heal, Stun etc. when you're choosing the relics and weapons. So, is this literally a goodbye to the ''archive'' option? Nah, you can always go back and check it out if you want.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43037518/296d13208bfd385bb69c55aeac0e7c832ca465af.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43037518/73a2611a511ec6600143cf319f92027ce9506bc1.png[/img]
[h2]🤔 Do the relics really work? 🤔[/h2]

We added more indicators for you to see whether the relic is active or not. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43037518/5e3feda181ae9d35278862a88ca03de0ee645ede.gif[/img]

Thank you for your support! See you very soon!

Cheers,

notes.title: The Land Beneath Us: Unleash Mythic Mayhem in Annwn's Underworld!
notes.content:
[h3]Hello Underworld Dwellers,

PID Games publishing label from sunny South of France is partnering up with FairPlay Studios, an indie game development studio from sunny South of Asia, to bring you a unique blend of a turn-based rogue-lite dungeon crawler, wow that’s a mouthful!

Well, long story short, the game is called The Land Beneath Us and interestingly enough, it’s rooted in Welsh mythology. You get to unleash cool skill combos and wield stylish weaponry in Annwn's Underworld. The objective is to conquer the Seven Lords, save The Creator, and retrieve vital Soul-Tech.[/h3]
 
[h2]We are delighted to announce that it is planned to be released next year! [/h2]

[h1]Watch the Gameplay Teaser and get teased lol[/h1]
[previewyoutube=0AzgqWVboSo;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]SYNOPSIS[/h2]
[h3][b]The Land Beneath Us[/b] is a turn-based rogue-lite action dungeon crawler. Use powerful skill combos and stylish weaponry to battle your way through the Underworld known as Annwn. Enjoy challenging dynamic encounters and discover the mysteries of this mythological world.[/h3]

[h2]KEY FEATURES[/h2]
[h3][b]BATTLE THROUGH THE UNDERWORLD! [/b]
Forged by The Creator, the Ultimate Soul Harvester (U.S.H) is crafted to gather Souls. Now armed with Soul-Technology, its mission is one of redemption. Explore The Underworld, engage, barter, or confront characters. Learn from their tales to shape your unique path. [/h3]

[h3][b]MASTER THE COMBOS! [/b]
Overcome enemies with powerful abilities, executing customizable movement combinations. Plan strategically through short, action-packed levels to maximize hits on creatures! [/h3]

[h3][b]VARIED ARSENAL [/b]
Strategize and wield a diverse array of weapons, from Blood Axes to Longinus Spears and Lazer Pistols. Equip different weapons in each slot for a dynamic hack 'n' slash journey through the Underworld. [/h3]

[h3][b]VARIED ARSENAL REPLAYABILITY FACTOR [/b]
Enhance stats and abilities by collecting souls from defeated enemies as you explore each world. Enjoy direct combat? Boost your Weapon skill tree. Prefer a strategic approach? Unlock potent Combo Abilities to hit enemies from a distance. [/h3]

[h2]Developers: FairPlay Studios[/h2]
[h3]FairPlay Studios started as a small group of like-minded individuals with a passion for gaming. Consisting of industry veterans and avid gamers, the FairPlay Studios team strives to create games that we, as gamers ourselves, would love to play.[/h3]

[h2]Publisher: PID Games[/h2]
[h3]PID Games is a publishing label created by Plug In Digital. We provide tailor-made publishing support for all platforms, from Ghost of a Tale to Paper Beast, including Alba: A Wildlife Adventure, PomPom, Skabma…[/h3]

[h3][i][b]P.S.[/b] A quote from the publisher: "We will harvest & gather all the souls. We are armed with the Soul Tech now lol"[/i][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43037518/699feba454ff123cb1feaadf7856ae352ba58a6d.png[/img]

[h1][b]WISHLIST NOW AND WAIT FOR THE DEMO LIKE OBEDIENT SOULS:[/b][/h1]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2131010/The_Land_Beneath_Us/
